interventions.speaker: CHAIR
interventions.who: the senior urologist who signs the decision
interventions.body: The prognosis is supported by several favorable factors, including negative surgical margins, absence of extraprostatic extension, and no documented lymph node metastasis. The pathological grade was Gleason 4+5 (ISUP group 5), which contributes to the risk profile. Conversely, the lack of seminal vesicle invasion and absent lymphovascular invasion are reassuring findings. Biopsy-to-prostatectomy differences cannot be assessed as the biopsy Gleason pattern and ISUP report are missing. Nodal status is documented with no metastasis found. The preoperative PSA was 11 ng/mL. Prognostic uncertainty remains due to the absence of postoperative PSA data and follow-up information, which would significantly refine risk assessment. The fixed estimated horizon is 56.82 months. This represents expected follow-up without an event, not a known recurrence date. The sensitivity range is 42.61–71.02 months; its coverage has not been validated.
